*Maps developed by Kiran using the tidycensus, sf and tmap packages, data from US Census*

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(sf)
library(tmap)
library(tidyverse)
library(rgeoda)
library(biscale)
library(cowplot)
library(RColorBrewer)


```

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Read-in shp
covid_zip <- st_read("NYC_covid19_zip.shp")
```

### Bivariate map showing Poverty and COVID-19 Deaths in NYC from 2020 to 2021
```{r, echo=FALSE}
tm_shape(covid_zip) +
  tm_polygons(col =  "per_pov",
              style = "quantile",
              n = 4,
              title = "Percent Poor",
              palette = "Purples",
              border.col = "black") +
  tm_shape(covid_zip) +
  tm_dots(col = "black",
          size = "r_death",
          style = "quantile",
          title = c("Death Rate"),
          palette = "Purples",
          border.col = "black")


```
